Standard
Open
Platform services
Not apps — capabilities that run inside apps
A service is not a destination. You never "open" a service; it works inside the applications above — grounding a draft, routing a model, sealing a report, signing an action. Listed here for transparency, not navigation.
RIM -- Regulatory Intelligence Model
The non-LLM judgment layer that accumulates regulatory precedent over time and powers every app's recommendations.
Evidence retrieval (RAG)
Grounds answers and drafts in the corpus and returns cited source chunks. Runs inside authoring, evidence and chat.
AnA gateway & model routing
Risk-tiered routing of every AI call to the right model, with human-review gates on high-impact actions.
Precedent engine
Deterministic search over past approvals and decisions; surfaced in Precedent, 510(k) SE and drafting.
Deterministic tool registry
142 pure-function regulatory tools (TTC, estimand, causality...) that AnA calls for submission-defensible output.
Deep-research orchestrator
Multi-connector fan-out and grounded synthesis that drives the Deep research app.
Template & rendering
Generates DOCX and PDF from governed templates -- produces the files in Artifacts Center and the editor.
E-signature (21 CFR Part 11)
Reason-for-change + identity re-assertion on governed actions across every app.
Audit hash-chain
Tamper-evident ss11.10(e) ledger written by every governed mutation.
Connectors
ClinicalTrials.gov, FAERS/MAUDE, EUDAMED, EHR/FHIR, DMS -- feed evidence and deep research.
